raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Assistant Manager – COCE Product Control (Asia Equities) BNP Paribas
Jan’24 – Feb 2026 Bangalore, India
Manage structured derivatives, options, and delta-one products for the Asia Equities desk. • Produce, review, and analyze daily intraday and end-of-day desk P&L, investigating FOBO breaks and ensuring timely resolution.
Verify and reconcile corporate action bookings, minimizing the risk of misstatements and ensuring the correct P&L impact.
Collaborate with trade support and quantitative research teams to validate trade bookings, review attributions, updating fixings, and driving book optimization.

Liaise with IT leads to enhance and automate end-of-day P&L batch delivery.
Address ad hoc trader and infrastructure queries with actionable insights on trading revenue drivers and risk exposures.
Verify and calculate management, broker etc. fees, corporate actions, interest rate swaps, certificates, stocks, and warrant bookings while minimizing risk of misstatement.
Perform control checks for dividend, stock split, bonus, IPO, and priority offer events, ensuring accurate pricing, quantity, and event records.
Ensure equity deal bookings align with term sheets and provide daily system and P&L sign-offs. • Maintain monthly liquidity reserves based on trader estimates and reconcile at month-end against actuals.
Senior Financial Controller – Treasury Product Control Credit Suisse
Jun 2022 – Dec 2023 Pune, India • Delivered daily, monthly, and quarterly P&L reporting and variance analysis for Treasury portfolios based on accruals
and funding attributes.
Performed daily independent verification of Treasury trading and investment P&L, incorporating trading strategies, risk exposures, and complex accounting treatments to provide actionable insights.
Managed daily reconciliation of Profits and Losses (P&L), Mark-to-Market (MTM), and positions for Treasury and Investment businesses, reconciling with the General Ledger (GL) and assisting Finance during month-end closing
Reconciled actual vs. estimated P&L and prepared flash and actual variance analyses for Fixed Income and Equity products.
• Handled products such as Repo, Reverse Repo, Money Market loans and deposits, and FX instruments,
ensuring accurate integration into Credit Suisse’s financial environment.
Partnered with traders, auditors, valuation specialists, and entity finance teams to resolve complex valuation and accounting issues.
Acted as team lead during the manager’s absence, overseeing process optimization and successfully migrating

reporting functions from Poland. Supported GAAP & IFRS-based financial disclosures and implemented robust financial controls to enhance transparency.

Ensured the accuracy of rates (including FX, benchmark interest rates, and other asset prices) uploaded into the treasury system from information providers such as Bloomberg.
Fund Accountant Citi Corp
Sep 2020 – Apr 2022 Pune, India
Reconciled portfolio and fund accounts (PA vs. FA), resolving breaks efficiently. • Calculated and reconciled Net Asset Value (NAV) and conducted in-depth fund performance analysis, highlighting key variances and trends for management and client review.
Monthly reconciliations of cash, positions, and market values between internal books and external counterparties • Reviewed Fund expenses, Management fees and ensure accurate recording in the internal books

Investigated and processed complex corporate actions including rights issues, mergers, acquisitions, spin-offs, and dividends, ensuring accurate reporting.
Reviewed and verified trade bookings across trade, settlement, and accounting dates, amounts, and FX rates on a T+1 basis.
Processed and reconciled SWIFT messages (MT564/566), ensuring accurate and timely bookings in fund accounting systems.
Worked on Investran for fund accounting operations like maintaining investor records, reconciliation, reporting activities etc.

Liaised with global custodians such as Citi, JPM, BNY, RBC, and Goldman Sachs to resolve custody queries, settlement breaks, and position mismatches effectively.
Intern – Chartered Accountancy Firm Saket Saraf & Co.
Jan 2018 – Mar 2018 Ranchi, India
Performed bookkeeping, voucher verification and journal entry postings. • Prepared and filed income tax returns for individuals, partnerships, and corporations. • Assisted in GST computation, filing, and reconciliation.
